text:
Jana: Quick mock — hovering a series opens an inline 'inspector' with series unit, sample points, and data-range. Shows: 'Requests • pct • avg latency' so people know units without digging. Screenshot: <link>
Tom: Love the inspector. Can we make it keyboard-focusable? tabbing should open the same panel. a11y nit: role=dialog for the inspector and aria-live updates when content changes.
Li: Agreed on keyboard. Also: for multi-unit charts, we should show unit badges in the legend next to the name (small, muted). Otherwise people assume all series share units.
Evan: UX question: how do we handle outliers in this view? currently spikes blow the y-scale. Proposals: 1) clip with a small chevron showing clipped value, 2) fade outliers visually and show precise value in the inspector, 3) log-scale toggle.
Jana: My vote is (2) fade + inspector. Less surprising than hard clipping. We can show faded points with tooltip: 'value beyond 99th percentile — click for raw'. :information_source:
Tom: Implementation thought: fade by reducing alpha to 0.25 for points > percentileThreshold. Add visual affordance: tiny label 'outlier' when hovered. Also add setting in chart options: outlierHandling: 'fade' | 'clip' | 'truncate'.
Li: Copy tweak for legend: instead of 'requests' use 'requests (rps)' when unit is known. Short and scannable. For missing units show '?' badge and inspector will explain source of unit.
Evan: Performance: careful with per-point DOM updates. Inspector should sample aggregated stats, not list thousands of points. Use precomputed percentiles from the backend for fade decisions.
Tom: Small code snippet for focus behavior:
```
.legend-item:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--interactive); }
.legend-item:focus .inspector { display:block; }
```
Jana: Accessibility copy: inspector should have heading 'Series details' and each row: label + value + unit with aria-label like 'median 120 milliseconds'.
DesignBot: Deploy check: leave smoothing off by default for time-series with spikes. Toggle labeled 'Apply smoothing (experimental)'. If enabled, add a small pill showing the window size.
Li: One more visual nit: when multiple units present, show a subtle separator line in the legend to group series by unit. Helps scanning.
Evan: For charts with autoscaling, add a tiny 'scale locked' button to pin the Y range once a developer inspects the outlier behavior.
Tom: Can we get a quick prototype in storybook? I'll put together a simple interactive with toggles (fade/clip/log, smoothing on/off, inspector). Anyone want to pair tomorrow 10am?
Jana: I'll join. I'll also add copy suggestions for legend tooltips.
Li: I'll DM the percentiles endpoint and example payload for the prototype.
Evan: 👍 thanks all. Leaving the final UX call to Jana + Tom for sign-off.
